MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "You Don't Know Me: Songs Of Cindy Walker feels like a natural choice because classic country songwriting connects with the country side of my listening history.",
    "That selection gives me a recognizable connection to songs and vocal melodies, which makes me willing to try it even though it is not an exact repeat of my recent listening."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Experimental rock and jazz-rock miss the appeal of my recent choices: I want melodic singing or relaxing classical music, rather than musical experimentation.",
    "Instrumental jazz may be enjoyable, but it does not meet my current preference for vocal music or classical relaxation. Hip-hop feels further from those interests.",
    "Titles such as 8, Tribe, and Sinner leave me uncertain about their connection to my tastes, so I would pass rather than assume they suit me."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in several kinds of music seems to have been taken as a reason to suggest almost any style, although my choices still have specific connections.",
    "A broad connection to mellow music, as with Greatest Slow Jams 1, is not enough on its own; the singers, melodies, and musical style matter to me."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated choices of vocal crossover and stage-related recordings suggest that expressive singing and clear melodies matter to me.",
    "My most recent choice of relaxing classical music suggests a calm listening mood, which experimental rock and hip-hop do not satisfy for me right now.",
    "I interact selectively, so I need a recognizable connection to my listening interests before choosing an unfamiliar recording."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my country interest once but mostly missed my current preference for melodic vocals and relaxing classical music."
}
